Name: Chrissy (CJB) - A Custom NPC By Seanie Dew
Author: seaniedew
AuthorLabel: Seanie Dew and Jello and Fellow Clown and Jazzy Bee and Poltergeister
Description:
[i]Chrissy is an NPC that you should download, as she is the best NPC to ever be added to this game. Even better than Pierre. She is Lewis' niece, but she is way more based.[/i]

The only mod you'll need is Content Patcher. If you find any glitches in the mod they are all intentional, and you are [i]cruel [/i]for suggesting otherwise.

Here's how to trigger her events:

[b][i]2 HEART EVENT: [/i][/b]
Enter Cindersnap Forest on a Tuesday

[b][i]4 HEART EVENT: [/i][/b]
Go to Town Square.

[b][i]6 HEART EVENT: [/i][/b]
Enter Lewis’ House during the day time

[b][i]6.5 HEART EVENT:[/i][/b]
The following morning Chrissy comes to your door.

[b][i]6.75 HEART EVENT:[/i][/b]
The next morning you get a letter in the mail, THEN head to the secret forest the following day

[b][i]8 HEART EVENT: [/i][/b]
Event starts by walking into Lewis’ house on a afternoon day.
[b][i]
10 HEART EVENT: [/i][/b]
You get a letter in the mail, then go to CinderSnap Forest the following Tuesday

[b][i]14 HEART EVENT: [/i][/b]
You get a letter in the mail, then go to the Town Square the Following Day
